description: Axe waivers for /, /book/, /book/chapter-1/, and /404. A violation that is not listed fails site CI. A listed violation that no longer reproduces also fails, so delete it once the page is clean. Optional "scheme" is "light" or "dark"; omit it to require the waiver in both. The 31 color-contrast waivers from the pre-visual-design styles no longer reproduce on main (fixed in #5; the heading-order skip was fixed in #8), so these lists are empty.
